title: 第28章 哥，是你啊
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
“哥，都认识。”

    “我过去一趟。”

    李西海打了个酒嗝，酒劲不小，他也醉了。

    李西雄道：“行，都认识就算了。”

    “尼玛，没规矩的东西。”

    他说的也不大声，对方也在杜鸿的劝说下先行离开的。

    杜鸿走过来，道：“哥，刚才真抱歉。”

    “都喝多了，有点上头。”

    “真对不住啊。”

    李西雄摆了摆手，大方的笑道：“西海的朋友，就是我的朋友。”

    “说这些话就见外了。”

    李西英道：“你也是江云的，以后回江云，要吃海鲜什么的，找我。”

    “好的哥。”

    杜鸿是江云土生土长的，他是知道李家在江云的实力。

    “雄哥，西朋喝多了，你看着点。”

    “没问题。”

    让他们先回包厢，李西海带着果盘，跟杜鸿去了他那边。

    两人还没怎么说上几句，就到了房间。

    包间内有好几个人，都是之前过道看见的。

    不过，他们隐隐都以其中一个人为主。

    包厢的音乐停了，灯光稍微调亮了一点，但相对来说还是有些昏暗。

    “大家都认识认识。”

    “这是我高中同学，李西海。”

    杜鸿道：“刚才是误会，大家都别见怪啊……。”

    “西海，来，我跟你介绍一下……。”

    李西海跟着过去看了看，但似乎有人在躲着他。

    “这位是李……。”

    若隐若现的灯光，从一个年轻人脸上一闪而过。

    李西海瞪大眼睛，“李飞？”

    声音不大，杜鸿跟其他人听的很清楚。

    认识？

    “西海，你认识李总？”

    杜鸿大为震惊的问道。

    “他是我弟啊。”

    李西海指着对方，笃定的说道。

    年轻人也不遮掩闪躲了，醉态之中带着些许尴尬，说道：“哥，是你啊。”

    还真是兄弟啊。

    这怎么可能。

    其他人都懵逼了。

    之前还跟李西海他们叫嚣的，这会儿都怀疑人生。

    李飞怎么也没想到，会在这里遇到本家兄弟。

    对方还记得自己。

    这属实是让他大感意外。
content_en:
"Brother, we all know each other."

    "I'll go over there."

    Li Xihai burped. The wine was quite strong and he was also drunk.

    Li Xixiong said: "Okay, just forget that we all know each other."

    "Nima, there are no rules."

    He didn't speak loudly, and the other party left first under Du Hong's persuasion.

    Du Hong came over and said, "Brother, I was so sorry just now."

    "They all drank too much and were a little drunk."

    "I'm so sorry."

    Li Xixiong waved his hand and said with a generous smile: "Friends in Xihai are my friends."

    "To say these things is to show your disapproval."

    Li Xiying said: "You are also from Jiangyun. When you return to Jiangyun in the future, if you want to eat seafood or something, come find me."

    "Okay brother."

    Du Hong was born and raised in Jiangyun, and he knew the strength of the Li family in Jiangyun.

    "Brother Xiong, west Peng drank too much, please keep an eye on him."

    "No problem."

    Let them go back to the box first. Li Xihai took the fruit plate and went to his place with Du Hong.

    The two of them arrived in the room without even exchanging a few words.

    There were several people in the private room, all of whom I had seen in the aisle before.

    However, they are all vaguely dominated by one of them.

    The music in the box stopped and the lights were slightly brighter, but still relatively dim.

    "We all know each other."

    "This is my high school classmate, Li Xihai."

    Du Hong said: "It was a misunderstanding just now, please don't take it personally..."

    "Xihai, come, let me introduce you..."

    Li Xihai followed him and took a look, but someone seemed to be avoiding him.

    "This is Li..."

    A faint light flashed across a young man's face.

    Li Xihai's eyes widened, "Li Fei?"

    The sound was not loud, and Du Hong and others could hear it clearly.

    know?

    "Xihai, do you know Mr. Li?"

    Du Hong asked in shock.

    "He is my brother."

    Li Xihai pointed at the other party and said firmly.

    The young man stopped trying to hide and dodge, and said with a little embarrassment in his drunken state: "Brother, it's you."

    They are really brothers.

    How is this possible.

    Everyone else was confused.

    Those who had yelled at Li Xihai and the others before were now doubting their lives.

    Li Fei never expected that he would meet his brothers here.

    The other party still remembers me.

    This really surprised him.
